device.description: A transistor: the subcircuit of the model library, and its parameters.

family.description: What the circuit is. device: a single-device characterization deck; test: a regression deck exercising simulator features.

category.description: The class a run-time benchmark sorts the circuit into, by what its cost is made of. analog_cell: amplifiers, references, regulators (set-up and many short analyses); switching: comparators, data converters, switched-capacitor circuits (time steps times device evaluation); oscillator: oscillators and PLL blocks (many cycles); post_layout: transistors inside a large RC network with coupling capacitors (the linear solve); high_voltage: power stages and stiff circuits; memory: arrays (size and repetition); rf: circuits at a carrier (periodic steady state). Left out where none applies: device and regression decks, linear networks.

size.description: The size a generated case writes this netlist at.

generator.description: A case written by circref/generate.py, with the generator's parameters; netlists state their size.

oneOf.description: An RC network on a graph; with diode, a diode from every node to ground. size: what the graph is sized by.

dc.description: The source's DC value: the operating point is solved at it, the transient starts from the pulse.

diode.description: The parameters of the diode model, as SPICE names them.

oneOf.description: Chains of CMOS inverters; with wire, an RC line per net with coupling to the next chain. size: the number of chains.

dc.description: The DC value of the input the operating point is solved at; every second chain is driven by its complement.

models.description: Dialect -> the lines that bring in the model library; the dialects the case is written in.

wire.description: The net between two inverters as an RC line; r, c and coupling are the totals of a net.

coupling.description: Capacitance to the same net of the next chain.
